text: Provides tools to fix formations done elsewhere and manage SAFEs and convertible notes post-formation

text: Attorney accounts unlock 40+ advanced legal products not available to the public
quote: Attorney accounts get access to over 40 advanced products that are not publicly available.

text: Lets users swap out or fully customize underlying document forms and language beyond standard fields
quote: If you need to customize documents beyond the provided fields, you can swap out the underlying forms for any of our products.

text: Logs every change made to a document set or workspace for accountability

text: Completes and submits IRS forms (e.g. EIN application) fully online without faxing

text: Lets founders apply for startup bank accounts with pre-filled applications

text: Includes features to assign tasks to co-founders and work together on filings

text: Forming a startup unlocks a legal dashboard for handling additional post-incorporation paperwork

text: Supports hiring employees, consultants, and advisors and issuing stock or options as compensation

text: Software makes it easy to customize key terms of legal documents being prepared

text: Allows looping in an attorney to review and comment on entered information

text: Supports real-time collaborative editing of a document set with multiple invited people

text: Attorneys can be set as automatic reviewers/observers on all client activity or added only when needed
